pace.note: changesPer10s counts abrupt changes (punctuation), not motion. A contrast-relative version of the measure gives the same answer (1.0-1.7 per 10 s; the launch-film reference, at the same contrast, gives 4.6-10.3), so the reading is real: new content arrives every 2-4 s, but it glides in (crossfades, slides, word-by-word builds) and rarely lands with a punch.
